 Tyson and Ken are back for another week of Inside Look. This week the two get to dissect a (checks notes) pretty sound football game from the Oregon Ducks.
 What was the difference in Oregon’s offense against Northwestern? What defensive adjustments did they make at halftime? And do the Ducks have a shot this weekend against Ohio State?
 Watch this week’s episode to find out.

 Tyson Alger covered the Ducks for The Oregonian and The Athletic before branching out on his own to create and run The I-5 Corridor. He has covered everything from Marcus Mariota’s Heisman Trophy-winning season to the Ducks’ first year in the Big 10.
